_about: The Cloud Run CPU service that plays playtests when no GPU is to be had (docs/playtest-cloudrun.md, "The CPU service"): the same server as gen-playtest, built from Dockerfile.cpu, WebGL on SwiftShader. One WebSocket = one browser tab, so containerConcurrency = tabsPerInstance and Gen's playtest-cloud-cpu lane admits maxInstances x tabsPerInstance tabs. Request-based billing: an instance bills only while a tab (or an encode) is connected, so there is no idle tail. Gen's settings.playtest.cloudrunCpu must match what is deployed: deploy.mjs --variant cpu prints the patch.
name: gen-playtest-cpu

prices.source: cloud.google.com/run/pricing, request-based billing, Tier 1 (us-east4), the same rates as server/cpu-cloudrun/service.json; not verified against the bill

why: SwiftShader draws WebGL on every vCPU it gets and the screencast's JPEGs take more; measured on J's PC (docs/playtest-cloudrun.md, "Measured"), one tab per 4 vCPU / 8 GiB instance plays a WebGL game at a usable frame rate, two halve it. 'slow' multiplies the boot wait and the default scenario limit (software rendering is slower to load and to play). us-east4 sits next to Gen (gen, gen-beta).
